config.export.includeToolResults.descrip: Includes a summarized version of tool output (commands, file reads) when exporting the session to Markdown.
config.export.maxToolResultChars.descrip: Maximum size, in characters, of each tool output included in the export.
config.sessions.resumeLocation.sidebar: In the Claude Code in the right side panel (integrated).
config.sessions.resumeLocation.descripti: Where the Resume button in the sessions panel opens the conversation.
config.releaseNotes.show.description: Opens the release notes the first time AgenteCode starts after an update.
config.usageBar.contextWindow.descriptio: Context window in tokens. 0 = automatic by model (1M for the 5 family, 200k for older models).
config.usageBar.showStatusBar.descriptio: Shows the items in the status bar. Turn off if you prefer to see usage only above the chat (usage-band plugin) or only in the side panel.
config.usageBar.showCost.description: Shows the estimated session cost (calculated from the API price table).
config.usageBar.showTurn.description: Shows the duration of the last turn.
config.usageBar.showSessionTime.descript: Shows the time since the session started.
config.usageBar.showLimits.description: Shows the 5h and 7d limits in the bar.
config.usageBar.limitsStaleMinutes.descr: Maximum age, in minutes, of the limits reading; beyond that they are no longer shown. Readings older than 10 min display their age.
config.usageBar.limitsSnapshotPath.descr: Path of usage-snapshot.json from the optional claude-usage-meter extension. Empty = ~/.claude-usage-meter/usage-snapshot.json.
config.usageBar.colorSession5h.descripti: Color of the 5h limit in the bar and panel: theme color id (charts.green, follows the theme) or hexadecimal (#7fbbb3). Empty = default bar color.
config.usageBar.colorWeekly7d.descriptio: Base color of the 7d limit in the bar and panel (until the gradient starts): theme color id (charts.green, follows the theme) or hexadecimal (#7fbbb3). Empty = default bar color.
config.usageBar.refreshLimits.descriptio: If the optional claude-usage-meter extension is active and the direct query is off, asks it for a fresh reading when the current one is older than 6 min.
config.usageBar.fetchLimitsDirectly.desc: Gets the 5h/7d limits by querying https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage (undocumented endpoint). Reads the Claude Code token (~/.claude/.credentials.json; on macOS, the Keychain) only for this query; several windows share a single query per interval. It is enabled by the first-run prompt or by the "Claude Usage: Enable 5h/7d Limits" command.
config.usageBar.directRefreshMinutes.des: Interval, in minutes, of the limits query while Claude is idle (with automatic backoff if the API rate-limits).
config.usageBar.activeRefreshSeconds.des: While Claude is in use, queries the limits with this minimum spacing, in seconds (at most one query per computer in that interval).
config.usageBar.colorGradient.descriptio: Gradually changes the color of the 5h and 7d limits and of the context, from the base color to red, as usage rises (see colorGradientStart, colorGradientAmber and colorGradientRed). When off, the color is fixed and only changes on alert.
config.usageBar.colorGradientStart.descr: Usage (%) from which the color starts moving from the base color toward amber. The context, which has no base color, only starts coloring at amber.
config.usageBar.colorGradientAmber.descr: Usage (%) at which the color reaches amber, halfway to red.
config.usageBar.colorGradientRed.descrip: Usage (%) from which the color is red and the bar background alert is turned on. Must be greater than amber, which must be greater than the start; out of order, 50, 75 and 90 apply.
config.sync.auto.description: Uploads local changes automatically after a few seconds of inactivity (only while connected).
config.sync.autoDelaySeconds.description: Wait time in seconds after the last change before triggering the automatic upload.
config.sync.checkOnStartup.description: Checks for remote updates in the Gist when AgenteCode starts.
config.sync.excludedSettings.description: Setting keys that will never be uploaded to the Gist (keys containing tokens, passwords or secrets are ignored automatically).
config.sync.syncSnippets.description: Includes the user's code snippets in the sync.
config.sync.syncExtensions.description: Includes the list of user-installed extensions in the sync.
config.review.terminalChanges.descriptio: Includes in the review the files changed by terminal commands (perl, sed, scripts) and by other tools, using git: AgenteCode takes a snapshot of the project at the start of each request to the agent and compares at the end. Only works in folders with git.
config.review.panel.webview: Dedicated screen, with Accept and Discard buttons, badges, colored numbers and expandable hunks.
config.review.panel.description: How the "Agent Changes" list is drawn in the side bar.
config.review.inlineHint.description: Also shows, at the end of the first line of each hunk changed by the agent, an italic label with the shortcuts Alt+Y (keep) and Alt+N (undo). The buttons above the hunk already show the shortcuts in their tooltip.
config.review.codeLens.description: Shows Keep and Undo above each hunk the agent changed, inside the file.
config.sync.syncClaudeConfig.description: Includes in the sync the global CLAUDE.md and the files in ~/.claude/commands, agents and skills (text only; files containing keys or tokens are skipped).
